$comment: HUP gate g3-licence: what scripts/third-party-notices.mjs scans for the third-party notices of the code compiled into the installer.

rust: one entry per Rust sidecar crate (and the app), scanned with cargo-about (release/about.toml) at <federation-root>/<repo>/<manifest> once per release target in targets, with the features the release build uses, then merged (the union of the crates; a crate that is not on every target lists the targets it is on). repo '.' is this repo.

go: Kubo's cmd/ipfs at the pinned version (keep in step with the kubo entry in release/licences.json), scanned once per platform (one per release target, as GOOS/GOARCH) and merged like rust, plus the Go standard library. clarify resolves modules go-licenses cannot classify: spdx plus the licence file inside the module (GOROOT/LICENSE for code under the Go authors' BSD licence that ships no file: whyrusleeping/base32, and alexbrainman/goissue34681, a Windows-only copy of Go's os code whose files say 'Copyright 2019 The Go Authors ... governed by a BSD-style license that can be found in the LICENSE file' and whose upstream repository has no LICENSE file of its own).

targets: every target triple an installer ships (macOS arm64, Linux x86_64 and aarch64, Windows x86_64); the notices header lists them. elect: crates offered under a choice that includes a licence outside the permissive list, with the permissive licence Citrate uses them under (cargo-about must have resolved exactly that licence's text); such a crate without an election is refused.
first_party_sources: package sources that are Citrate's own (left out of the notices; the inventory entry covers them). Path crates are always first party.

npm: the webview bundle (tauri.conf.json frontendDist), built by Vite with nothing written; only the packages whose modules or assets end up in the output are listed. allow: licences reviewed for this component only (OFL-1.1: the @fontsource fonts, bundled unmodified with their licence and copyright, which OFL-1.1 section 2 permits). clarify: a package with no licence file of its own (the Tauri JS plugins ship only LICENSE.spdx, declaring MIT OR Apache-2.0 for the Tauri Programme) takes the named files; run npm ci first.
Re-run collect and render whenever a sidecar is rebuilt for a release (docs/RELEASE.md, Cutting a release).
